summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Westport Fuel Systems Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, announcing the release date of its Q2 2026 financial results and a corresponding conference call. No special situation—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change—is involved. The filing merely provides standard quarterly earnings timing and is not a material event trigger. As a result, it does not qualify for any special-situation category.
